F_CU_1_ADJUDICATION.why_this_section_exists: LANE CU measured a defect that made the ORIGINALLY SPECIFIED refusal-subject contract mechanically unsatisfiable, and STOPPED rather than materialize it. The HPO adjudication that followed CHANGED the contract. This section preserves both the finding and the adjudication in the authority history, so that a future reader sees WHY the frozen contract has two shapes instead of one, rather than finding a two-shape contract with no recorded cause. Silently rewriting the original assumption is prohibited.
F_CU_1_ADJUDICATION.F_CU_1_STATEMENT: The originally specified contract froze, for BOTH refusal verbs, entity_type='organization' AND entity_id = the attempted organization UUID, while ALSO authorising the reason value TENANCY_NO_ORGANIZATION_SELECTED. Those three cannot hold simultaneously.

F_CU_1_MEASURED_PROOF.1_entity_id_is_NOT_NULL: MEASURED AT THREE INDEPENDENT LAYERS, all agreeing. db/baseline/stella_g2_schema.sql:3823 declares `entity_id uuid NOT NULL` inside CREATE TABLE public.audit_logs. db/schema.ts:95 declares `entityId: uuid('entity_id').notNull()`. And NO migration relaxes it: the only audit_logs DDL in db/migrations/ is the two foreign keys in 0000_quick_husk.sql, ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY in 0031_rls_core.sql, and the project_id FK in 0043_fib_audit_project_id_fk.sql. There is no ALTER COLUMN ... DROP NOT NULL anywhere.
F_CU_1_MEASURED_PROOF.2_the_no_selection_branches_have_no_UUID: MEASURED IN THE INTEGRATED S3 CORE. The reason TENANCY_NO_ORGANIZATION_SELECTED arises at exactly two boundaries, and NEITHER has an organization UUID available. (a) The selector app/(authenticated)/app/organizations/select/actions.ts refuses with error=missing_organization when the submitted organizationId is absent or empty after trim. (b) lib/auth/database-context.ts:402 returns organizationRefusalCode TENANCY_NO_ORGANIZATION_SELECTED when getSelectedOrganizationId() returns null - and lib/auth/selected-organization.ts returns null for BOTH an absent cookie AND a present-but-malformed value, via `if (!value || !UUID_PATTERN.test(value)) return null`.
F_CU_1_MEASURED_PROOF.3_the_additive_policy_does_not_fix_it: The LANE CK/CK-R2 finding F-1 concerned the audit_logs INSERT POLICY rejecting the row because it demands organization membership. The additive policy frozen below discharges F-1. But entity_id NOT NULL is a COLUMN constraint, not a policy predicate: no RLS policy can satisfy it, because a policy filters candidate rows and this row cannot be CONSTRUCTED in the first place. F-CU-1 is therefore a SECOND, INDEPENDENT obstacle that the CK/CK-R2 compilation did not measure.
F_CU_1_MEASURED_PROOF.why_this_was_not_caught_earlier: v1.0.23's AUDIT_VERB_DISPOSITION.measured_reason correctly identified the INSERT-policy obstacle and correctly deferred the verbs. It did not examine the audit_logs COLUMN constraints, because under S3 core the verbs were not being emitted at all. The obstacle only becomes reachable at the moment a successor node tries to construct the row.

F_CU_1_ADJUDICATION.ADJUDICATED_RESOLUTION: TWO-SHAPE REFUSAL AUDIT SUBJECT CONTRACT. The audit row MUST truthfully identify the subject that ACTUALLY EXISTS at the refusal boundary. Where a valid organization UUID assertion exists, the subject is that organization. Where none exists, the subject is the authenticated user. Both refusal reasons are retained exactly; neither obligation is discarded; the audit schema is not widened. F-CU-1 is resolved by TRUTHFUL SUBJECT TYPING, not by widening the audit schema.

REFUSAL_SUBJECT_CONTRACT.binding: EXACTLY TWO forms are authorised. A refusal audit row that matches neither form is a STOP, and the RLS policy frozen below is shaped so that the database itself refuses it.
REFUSAL_SUBJECT_CONTRACT.governing_definition: TENANCY_NO_ORGANIZATION_SELECTED means NO VALID ORGANIZATION UUID ASSERTION EXISTS AT THIS REFUSAL BOUNDARY. It does NOT mean 'the user did not click anything'. Absent, empty, malformed and otherwise-unusable assertions are ALL the same case, and they are all FORM A.

FORM_A.name: NO VALID ORGANIZATION ASSERTION
FORM_A.applies_when: No valid organization UUID assertion exists at the refusal boundary: the assertion is absent, empty, malformed / non-UUID, or otherwise unavailable as a valid organization UUID.
FORM_A.do_not_manufacture_a_subject: BINDING. Do NOT manufacture an organization subject merely because hostile or malformed input contained arbitrary bytes. The bytes are not an organization, and recording them as one would both lie and create a write-anything channel into entity_id.

FORM_B.name: VALID ORGANIZATION UUID, MEMBERSHIP REFUSED
FORM_B.applies_when: A VALID organization UUID assertion exists, but the authenticated subject does not hold the required active membership in it.
FORM_B.entity_id: the exact valid attempted/selected organization UUID
FORM_B.no_existence_lookup: BINDING. No organization existence lookup may be added merely to emit this event. A deleted or nonexistent organization carrying a valid UUID remains OBSERVATIONALLY INDISTINGUISHABLE from ordinary non-membership - which is exactly the property v1.0.23's S3-4 established and which this node must not undo.
FORM_B.why_organization_id_is_still_NULL_in_FOR: The row is an event ABOUT the attempted organization, never an event OWNED by that tenant. Setting organization_id would assert a tenancy relationship the refusal exists to deny, would require membership in the refused organization to write, and would make the row readable by that organization's members. entity_id is DESCRIPTIVE SUBJECT METADATA ONLY.

ACTION_SEMANTICS.forms_are_orthogonal_to_actions: BOTH actions may legitimately occur with EITHER form, depending on whether a valid organization UUID assertion exists at that action's own boundary. The action names WHERE the refusal happened; the form names WHAT the subject was. They are independent axes and the policy must not couple them.

ACTION_SEMANTICS.no_new_reasons: BINDING. Do NOT create additional refusal reasons merely to distinguish malformed input from absent input. The two reason values are exhaustive by adjudication.
ACTION_SEMANTICS.no_user_visible_change: BINDING. This is an AUDIT CLASSIFICATION contract. It does NOT authorise changing user-visible selection or refusal semantics, and it is NOT permission to reopen S3 core.

AUDIT_LOG_POLICY_CONTRACT.binding: ONE additive INSERT policy on public.audit_logs. It is a NARROW INSERT-SHAPE WALL, never an organization oracle.
AUDIT_LOG_POLICY_CONTRACT.additive_not_replacing: BINDING. The existing audit_logs_insert_member_or_admin policy is BYTE-UNCHANGED. This policy is ADDED beside it. Widening the old generic policy is a STOP.
AUDIT_LOG_POLICY_CONTRACT.semantic_shape: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "audit_logs_insert_tenancy_refusal" ON audit_logs; CREATE POLICY "audit_logs_insert_tenancy_refusal" ON audit_logs FOR INSERT TO uellix_app WITH CHECK ( actor_user_id = auth.uid() AND organization_id IS NULL AND project_id IS NULL AND action IN ('tenancy.organization.selection_refused','tenancy.membership.revalidation_refused') AND before_json IS NULL AND after_json IS NULL AND ip_address IS NULL AND user_agent IS NULL AND ( (reason = 'TENANCY_NO_ORGANIZATION_SELECTED' AND entity_type = 'user' AND entity_id = auth.uid()) OR (reason = 'TENANCY_SELECTED_ORGANIZATION_NOT_A_MEMBER' AND entity_type = 'organization' AND entity_id IS NOT NULL) ) );
AUDIT_LOG_POLICY_CONTRACT.semantic_guidance_only: The SQL above is SEMANTIC GUIDANCE, not permission to implement in this lane, and not a byte-exact mandate. The implementation must satisfy the INVARIANTS below; exact formatting, the DROP-then-CREATE idiom and statement ordering follow the repository's existing migration conventions.

exactly_one_subject_form_required.FORM_A_disjunct: reason = 'TENANCY_NO_ORGANIZATION_SELECTED' AND entity_type = 'user' AND entity_id = auth.uid()
exactly_one_subject_form_required.FORM_B_disjunct: reason = 'TENANCY_SELECTED_ORGANIZATION_NOT_A_MEMBER' AND entity_type = 'organization' AND entity_id IS NOT NULL
exactly_one_subject_form_required.why_the_disjunction_is_inside_the_policy: Because the correlation is the whole point. A policy that merely allowed reason IN (both) AND entity_type IN (both) would accept the CROSS PRODUCT - a FORM A row wearing entity_type='organization', or a FORM B row whose entity_id is the caller's own user id. Those are precisely the two forgeries RA-SUBJECT-5 and RA-SUBJECT-7 exist to catch, and the database must refuse them without relying on the emitter being correct.
exactly_one_subject_form_required.entity_id_NOT_NULL_is_restated_deliberat: entity_id IS NOT NULL in the FORM B disjunct is redundant against the column constraint and is stated anyway, so the policy remains self-describing if it is ever read apart from the table definition.

what_the_database_CANNOT_prove.binding: DISCLOSED, NOT PAPERED OVER. The policy can prove that a FORM B row carries SOME valid non-null uuid in entity_id. It CANNOT prove that this uuid is THE organization the subject actually attempted, because proving that would require the very organizations-table lookup this contract forbids.
what_the_database_CANNOT_prove.consequence: The 'entity_id equals the actual attempted UUID' obligation is an APPLICATION-LEVEL oracle, discharged by control RA-SUBJECT-8, not by the policy. An implementation that claims the policy proves it is wrong.
what_the_database_CANNOT_prove.why_the_lookup_stays_forbidden: An existence check against public.organizations inside an INSERT policy would turn every refusal write into an organization-existence oracle for an unauthenticated-in-that-tenant subject - reintroducing exactly the leak FORM B's no_existence_lookup clause and v1.0.23's S3-4 both close.
